items.title: Public Hearing to approve the Ultra-High Efficiency Toilet Rebate Program and adopt Rules and Regulations by issuing rebates to customers who purchase and install Premium certified ultra-high efficiency toilets
items.text: Public Hearing to approve the Ultra-High Efficiency Toilet Rebate Program and adopt Rules and Regulations to allow the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission to continue to promote indoor water efficiency in its retail service area, by issuing rebates to customers who purchase and install U.S. Environmental Protection Agency WaterSense, Maximum Performance tested Premium certified ultra-high efficiency toilets to replace existing toilets with a maximum rated flush volume of 1.1 gallons per flush

items.title: Public Hearing to consider the adoption of (1) rates of the San Francisco Public UtilitiesCommission Power Enterprise for Hetch Hetchy Power service (2) revision of existing fees for rental of certain facilities to hold
items.text: Public Hearing to consider the adoption of (1) rates of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Power Enterprise for Hetch Hetchy Power service, to be effective with meter readings beginning on or after July 1, 2025 and (2) revision of existing fees for rental of certain facilities beginning May 1, 2025 and updated on July 1, 2026. Separately, SFPUC staff are proposing to hold CleanPowerSF rates flat for Fiscal Year (FY) 2025-26. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.text: Approve Southeast Community Center Digital Equity Operator Grant Program revisions to increase the annual grant award to a total not-to-exceed amount of $200,000; and authorize the General Manager to execute a grant agreement under the revised Grant program.
